534.01 PURPOSE AND INTENT OF WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION REGULATIONS The purpose of this Article is to regulate the placement, construction, and m odification of wireless telecommunication facilities and their support structures in order to protect the public health, safety and morals, while at the same time not unreasonably interfering with the development of the competitive wireless telecommunicati ons industry in the Miami Valley Region.
